description: This file contains shared plugin functions for the Smarty templating engine, specifically for converting between characters and Unicode code points using multibyte string functions.

methods.name: smarty_mb_to_unicode
methods.description: Converts characters to their decimal Unicode equivalents using mb_convert_encoding and unpack.

methods.name: smarty_mb_from_unicode
methods.description: Converts Unicode code points back to characters in a specified encoding using pack and mb_convert_encoding.
